response.original_title: 【Quick_Help】 How can I add a room to my Disney Cruise?
response.overview: To add another room to an existing Disney Cruise 1-866-254-7549 reservation, you must book a separate new stateroom and call Disney Cruise customer service at +1-866-254-7549(US) or contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. Book a separate cabin: You cannot add a room to an existing reservation through the online website or mobile app. Book a new stateroom online or via phone. Contact Disney Cruise at +1-866-254-7549(US) or your travel agent. You cannot directly add a new physical stateroom to an existing reservation online; instead, you must book a separate room and have it linked by calling Disney Cruise customer service at +1-866 254-7549 or by contacting your travel advisor. To add an extra room to an existing Disney Cruise reservation, call Disney Cruise at +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) or contact your travel advisor, as new cabins cannot be added to an existing booking online.
